title: Practice 5: за-: behind, and dropping in

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Лука Силыч опять ___ (залетать / залететь — to fly) по комнатам.
exercises.why: Movement deep into something, at a great distance (inside, upwards or downwards): Мяч залетел на крышу дома. — The ball flew onto the roof of the house. — в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst.. **за-** (temporal) — Beginning of multidirectional movement, with multidirection verb of motion — Она забегала по комнате. — She started running around the room. — по + dat.. **зайти́** — **заходи́ть** — to go (to see), to come in (to see, etc.), to call, to drop in; to pick up, to fetch. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  From Андрей Белый, «Серебряный голубь».
exercises.context: Movement deep into something, at a great distance (inside, upwards or downwards): Мяч залетел на крышу дома. — The ball flew onto the roof of the house. — в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst..

exercises.q: По доброй воле сюда не ___ (заехать / заезжать — to drive into)!
exercises.why: Автомашина заезжает за дом. (b) Dropping in on somebody or stopping by at a certain place: заходить, зайти — в магазин, на почту, к учителю. (c) Dropping in or stopping by to fetch something or someone — заходить, зайти за + Instr.: Я зайду за вами. — I'll stop by to pick you up. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Остров Сахалин».
exercises.context: Автомашина заезжает за дом.

exercises.q: Рано фикусы ___ (завести / заводить — to take, to bring, to lead).
exercises.why: **завести́** — **заводи́ть** — to take, to bring, to lead; to get, to procure, to acquire, to buy. **завезти́** — **завози́ть** — to take (to a place), to drop off (at a place); to supply, to deliver. **зале́зть** — **залеза́ть** — to climb up (finished action); (also figurative) to get into, to scramble. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Алексей Н. Толстой, «Хождение по мукам».
exercises.context: завести́** — **заводи́ть — to take, to bring, to lead; to get, to procure, to acquire, to buy.

exercises.q: Пиявки ___ (заползти / заползать — to crawl into) в карман курточки.
exercises.why: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Алексей Н. Толстой, «Золотой ключик, или Приключения Буратино».
exercises.context: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).
